description: This file defines the interface for a preemphasis filter used in AMR speech codec, including type definitions, function prototypes for reset, exit, and processing, and a structure for filter state.

methods.name: preemphasis_reset
methods.description: Resets the preemphasis filter state, setting memory to zero.

methods.name: preemphasis_exit
methods.description: De-initializes the preemphasis filter, freeing the state structure.

methods.name: preemphasis
methods.description: Applies preemphasis filtering to the input signal using the filter state and coefficient.
